title: Acidic oxide
content: An acidic oxide is a non-metallic oxide which reacts with basic oxide to produce salt.
e: Acidic oxide is defined as follows. An acidic oxide is a non-metallic oxide which reacts with basic oxide to produce salt. Acidic oxides are usually non-metal oxides that make acids with water or react with bases.

title: Basic oxide
content: A basic oxide is a metallic oxide which reacts with acid to form salt and water.
e: Basic oxide is defined as follows. A basic oxide is a metallic oxide which reacts with acid to form salt and water. Basic oxides are usually metal oxides that react with acids to make salt and water.

title: Amphoteric oxide
content: An amphoteric oxide is a metallic oxide which possesses both basic and acidic properties.
e: Amphoteric oxide is defined as follows. An amphoteric oxide is a metallic oxide which possesses both basic and acidic properties. An amphoteric oxide, such as ZnO, can react with both acids and bases.

title: Neutral oxide
content: A neutral oxide does not react with either acids or bases.
e: Neutral oxide is defined as follows. A neutral oxide does not react with either acids or bases. A neutral oxide such as CO or N2O does not form an acid or a base with water.

title: Peroxide
content: A peroxide reacts with an acid to produce salt and hydrogen peroxide.
e: Peroxide is defined as follows. A peroxide reacts with an acid to produce salt and hydrogen peroxide. A peroxide contains an O-O link, as in H2O2 or BaO2.

title: Compound oxide
content: A compound oxide is the combination of two different oxides of the same element.
e: Compound oxide is defined as follows. A compound oxide is the combination of two different oxides of the same element. A compound oxide behaves as if two oxides are combined, like Pb3O4.

title: Allotrope
content: Allotrope refers to two or more forms of an element that occur in the same physical state but different in properties.
e: Allotrope refers to two or more forms of an element that occur in the same physical state but different in properties. Allotropes are different forms of the same element, such as oxygen and ozone, or diamond and graphite.

title: Silver nitrate test
content: Silver nitrate test is used to detect the presence of halide ions.
e: Silver nitrate test is used to detect the presence of halide ions. Acidified silver nitrate is a test for chloride: a white precipitate of AgCl appears.
